thread:
Renee Alvarez: Follow-up from PM: recurring SLO breaches during model swapovers. We need clear owners, a RACI, and tickets. Keep it tight — prefer hotfix + longer-term design.
Omar Li: I can pick the hotfix to reduce swap latency (aim 7bd). Will draft INF-9123.
Ben Cho: I'll take the instrumentation + dashboard updates so we can spot regressions.
Sofia Ruiz: I'll own the rollout gating and acceptance criteria. Want a rollback threshold defined.
Renee Alvarez: Good. Please create two tickets: INF-9123 (hotfix) and INF-9124 (swap lifecycle redesign). Add label pm-followup.
Omar Li: Creating INF-9123 now: model-swap fast-path + backoff. Target 7bd.
ops-bot: New Jira created by Omar: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9123 (INF-9123)
Ben Cho: INF-9124 created for lifecycle redesign: includes warm-starts, cache priming, and swap telemetry. Target 4w.
ops-bot: New Jira created by Ben: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9124 (INF-9124)
Sofia Ruiz: RACI suggestion: R: Omar (hotfix), Ben (metrics/design), A: Renee (PM signoff), C: Sofia (gating), I: Eng-oncall + Support.
Omar Li: Hotfix plan: 1) reduce model load blocking during swap 2) add adaptive backoff to requests 3) smoke tests and canary.
Ben Cho: I'll add "swap-latency-90p" metric and a dashboard. Also adding an alert when swap-latency > 500ms for 2m.
Sofia Ruiz: Rollout plan: internal canary -> beta orgs -> prod. Rollback if error-rate > 0.8% sustained 10m.
Renee Alvarez: Checkpoints: 48h status update, demo after 5bd, full review when INF-9123 is complete. If owner is offline >3bd pass to rotation lead (Ben).
Omar Li: Assigned INF-9123 to me and added the pm-followup label.
Ben Cho: Assigned INF-9124 to myself and linked INF-9123 as dependent.
ops-bot: Labels updated: INF-9123, INF-9124 tagged with "pm-followup"
Renee Alvarez: Great. Post PRs and short logs here. We'll reassess if pattern persists and consider a sprint. Ping me @Renee for priority. :white_check_mark:
